items.d: A graduation tower used for the evaporation of brine to produce salt. The resulting salt water droplets in the air are said to benefit health. You can also climb to the top for views of the area.
The Franciscan monastery was built in 1648, and distinguished by its high bell tower in red and white bricks. Four out of the original seven buildings of the monastery remain today.
Transport museum with various old trams and buses on display.

Might be having a bit of a moment with regards to being in operation, but has an intriguing collections of sculptures and other art. Just check with the people at the chamber of commerce there if it's not appearing open.

n.en: National Museum of Arts and Traditions

items.d: This museum is made up of a cluster of houses with furnishings and displays appropriate to an Omani house between 1950 and 1970, i.e. before the accession of Sultan Qaboos. There is also a small modern art gallery.
The tomb of Khan Jahan Ali is a major pilgrimage site in the area, and hundreds of visitors stop here daily to pay their respects to one of the country's more famous holy men.
Museum in two floors presenting objects of daily life 200 years ago as well as the works of scientists and explorers that have lived and worked in the town.
Capacity 60,700. Their women's team play in Liga F (their top tier) at the nearby Luis del Sol training ground.
A canyon of winding rivers, covered in lush moss and dramatic cliffs.

This is a small uninhabited island with three grown trees in the middle. It's covered by white sands and washed by turquoise water with stunning underwater beauty. There are no toilets, bars or rooms.
Includes some interesting animals like camels and donkeys suited to life in the Karakum Desert and the Turkomen dog.
Rental of snowboards, cross-country skis, snow scooters and other winter sports equipment. Friendly and efficient owner who can provide information on snow and ice conditions.
Monastery belonging to the Greek-Melkite Catholic Church.
This is the site where King Nadir Shah and his son, Zahir Shah, are buried. Restored in 2012 after being damaged during the wars.

n.en: Mausoleum of Nadir Shah and Zahir Shah

items.d: One of the largest breweries in the country.

A nice way to see the city and its surroundings is from a small cruise ship. There are cruises of an hour or an hour and a half around the city or the surrounding archipelago, leaving every half an hour or so all day, some with…
Top end theater and musicals

Built on the site of the former city fortifications, this star-shaped park is the oldest public garden in Germany. It features scenic walking paths, colorful flowerbeds, and the historic "Am Wall" windmill.

The main tourist attraction is Laura Beach on the western tip of the main island about 40 km away from town. As taxis to Laura Beach are quite expensive the added value of a rental car should not be neglected.

Seo Market, located in Seogyo-dong, is the largest and traditional market in Yeosu for more than 100 years. It is a general market that sells various items such as marine products, clothing, and meat.
Volo Volo market is the biggest in the city, and the island. It will give you an insight into local culture and life. It's better to visit in the morning when it is bursting with energy.
Information on points of interest and Presidio history is available at the Visitor Center. Several videos can be viewed in the theater and a bookstore offers topical books and other media.

n.en: William Penn Mott, Jr. Visitor Center

items.d: Isaac Newton realised that what caused the apple to fall was the very same force moving the moon, planets and stars. James Clerk Maxwell (1831-1879) was born in this house, before the family moved to Kirkcudbright.
One of the most important churches in barroco style around the world.
Based on archaeological excavations of Byzantine buildings, artifacts of Roman/Byzantine/Islamic periods, ancient mosaics, and there is the Zacchaeus tree in the beautiful park.
Completed in 1973, it is the nation's largest sandstone dam. It was built for flood control, water supply, and hydroelectric power in the Han River basin.

n.en: Soyang River Dam Completion Memorial Tower

items.d: Built in 1892-4, in Neogothic style.
On a rainy day worth a visit. It has recorded guiding in English and a collection of Medieval and Renaissance Christian art.
This cathedral, built in the 19th century, is the city's main cathedral. It is across from City Hall.
The House of Venus, towards the eastern side of the city under a prominent cypress tree, was one of the most luxurious residences in the city.

Large bullring with a seating capacity of 15,000 spectators, built in 1967. Bullfights are usually held in winter. Hosts the "Bullfight Carnival of America" event. The venue is sometimes used for concerts or special events.
Amusement park.

Commemorates the 6,300 students who were conscripted to work in munitions factories and killed by the atomic bomb. There are statues of doves scattered throughout its five levels; at the base is a beautiful Kannon statue, always…

n.en: Memorial Tower to the Mobilized Students

items.d: The museum has a model of Temur's empire from Egypt to Kashgar and some artefacts from Buddhist and Zoroastrian times.
The Historical Museum of Fier stands as the sole museum in the city, housing a collection of 1800 objects within its holdings.
One of the main parks at the centre of the city. Not much to see really but sometimes they have some attractions. At Christmas they decore it very nicely.
Concierge service dive shop. It is limited to three people per dive, and offer a Monday to Friday schedule where the person dives 14 times in 5 days. Also offers a liveboard option.
A botanical reserve of great importance, which hosts many oak trees which are emblematic of the region's vegetation.
This small Buddhist temple at the foot of Mount North Jialiwan is the original facility of the world-famous Tzu-zhi Buddhist foundation.
Built in the 1920s by a private donor called Hasan Mustafa Sharkas and situated on a hill, this mosque impresses through its black and white striped walls.
